quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA Introduces DSX POD AI Factories to Accelerate (10-21-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: NVIDIA (release): NVIDIA introduced DSX POD, a reference design for complete Vera Rubin AI factories built by partners in modular containers, integrated and validated before delivery, reducing deployment time at a prepared site from six months to as little as 14 days; NVIDIA is working with Anduril, Armada, Bull, Crusoe, DayOne, Dell Technologies, Delta, Eaton, Foxconn (Ingrasys), GIGABYTE, HPE, Lenovo, Pegatron, Quanta Cloud Technology, Schneider Electric, Vertiv and Wistron to deliver DSX POD AI factories worldwide in early 2027.
quarterly_data.figure: deployment time from six months to as little as 14 days; deliveries early 2027
